name: Proton Saga (1985)
creation_method: Original procedural Blender Python authored with Codex
accuracy_notes: Reference-led silver interpretation of the original 1985 four-door Saga sedan. The lower sculpted bonnet and beltline, taller tapered glazing, thin sheet-metal pillars, rear quarter-light dividers, parked wipers, small pressed-steel wheels and high-profile tires were refined from owner-supplied images. Recessed open lamp housings expose modeled reflector bowls and bulbs beneath thin clear ribbed lenses. Continuous wraparound bumpers and segmented rear lamps use approximate shapes. A basic right-hand-drive cabin is visible; no engine, opening panels, exact factory trim or paint match is claimed. The sun-and-shield detail is a simplified original crest. Reference-image specifications were not independently verified. This is an artistic reconstruction, not a scanned or engineering-accurate replica.
